clips.prompt: The exact same four researchers in pale grey protective suits with dark boots, gloves, and compact black equipment cases stand steady on a dark industrial scissor lift with black rails; all four remain fully visible on the platform for the entire shot. Above them, a thin dark slit in the huge matte-black ovoid vessel's underside slowly widens into a clean black rounded-rectangle aperture. The lift rises slowly and smoothly toward the opening while the camera stays completely locked on a tripod; any change in framing comes only from the lift's gentle ascent. Around them, a misty grey field under a desaturated green-grey sky, 35mm film grain, low contrast, soft fog and haze, documentary stillness. Audio: low wind, air-pressure hush, faint electric lift motor.
